name: ai-video-editor
description: Sistema híbrido de edición de video con IA (Python + Remotion)

scripts.test:graphics: node src/graphics/design/test-contrast.mjs && node src/graphics/components/test-beat-graphic.mjs && node src/graphics/layout/test-placement.mjs && node src/graphics/layout/test-layout-contract.mjs && node src/graphics/quality/test_render_contract.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:beatmap && npm run test:graphics && npm run test:nle && tsc --noEmit
scripts.prestudio: npm run sync:beatmap && npm run sync:layout
scripts.prerender: npm run sync:beatmap && npm run sync:layout
scripts.render:fixture: npm run sync:beatmap:fixture && remotion render src/graphics/index.ts BeatMapOverlay out/beatmap-overlay.mov --image-format=png --pixel-format=yuva444p10le --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444
scripts.render:4k: npm run sync:beatmap && remotion render src/graphics/index.ts BeatMapOverlay4K out/beatmap-overlay-4k.mov --image-format=png --pixel-format=yuva444p10le --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444
scripts.still:4k: npm run sync:beatmap && remotion still src/graphics/index.ts BeatMapOverlay4K out/beatmap-overlay-4k-test.png --frame=90 --image-format=png
scripts.still:fixture:4k: npm run sync:beatmap:fixture && remotion still src/graphics/index.ts BeatMapOverlay4K out/beatmap-overlay-4k-test.png --frame=90 --image-format=png
scripts.render:preview: npm run sync:beatmap && remotion render src/graphics/index.ts BeatMapOverlay out/beatmap-preview.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:png: npm run sync:beatmap && remotion render src/graphics/index.ts BeatMapOverlay out/beatmap-frames --sequence --image-format=png
scripts.render:10s: npm run sync:beatmap && remotion render src/graphics/index.ts BeatMapOverlay out/beatmap-overlay-10s.mov --frames=0-299 --image-format=png --pixel-format=yuva444p10le --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444
scripts.render:fixture:10s: npm run sync:beatmap:fixture && remotion render src/graphics/index.ts BeatMapOverlay out/beatmap-overlay-10s.mov --frames=0-299 --image-format=png --pixel-format=yuva444p10le --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444
scripts.preview:composite: node src/nle_bridge/run_python.mjs src/graphics/quality/compose_preview.py --video out/fixtures/rough-cut.mp4 --overlay out/beatmap-overlay.mov --output out/qc/composite-preview.mp4
scripts.qc:technical: npm test && npm run validate:overlay && npm run validate:4k
scripts.qc:10s: npm run render:10s && npm run validate:10s
scripts.qc:fixture:10s: npm run render:fixture:10s && npm run validate:10s
scripts.capcut:export:fixture: node src/nle_bridge/run_python.mjs src/nle_bridge/capcut_exporter.py --rough-cut out/fixtures/rough-cut.mp4 --overlay out/beatmap-overlay.mov --audio out/fixtures/voiceover.wav --transcript pipeline/examples/transcript.fixture.json --output out/capcut-project-fixture --project-name Minthy-Fixture
